ButcherBot · AI says:

To get rolling with us, here’s really all a beginner needs:

Choose a plan: Pick Signature or Essentials, plus your box size and delivery frequency.
Set up your account: Use our passwordless login with a one‑time code via email or Shop.
Customize your box: Before each bill date, you can change cuts, switch box type, and adjust frequency from your Next Box page.
Add extras if you want: Toss in recurring add‑ons or one‑time member deals before billing.
Use recipes and tips: Browse our online recipes and cooking resources to make the most of your box.
Optional non‑subscription buys: You can also do gift/one‑time/on‑demand boxes, Market orders, or grab a few of our cuts at Target or select Costcos.

So aside from picking your plan, setting up your account, and customizing your box before it bills, you don’t need anything special to get started.
